live.instructions: Search Limodia's marketplace of independent luxury chauffeur operators. Pickup time is not required for search. Before helping the user book, obtain the pickup time and call the search tool with a complete datetime; only then present the returned prefilled booking link. Never guess a pickup time.

tools.name: search_car_service_operators
tools.title: Search luxury car service operators
tools.description: Use this tool when the user asks to book, find, search for, hire, compare, price, or get a quote for a limo, limousine, black car, executive sedan, chauffeur, town car, SUV, stretch limo, party bus, sprinter van, airport transfer, or luxury car service. Search Limodia's marketplace of independent luxury chauffeur and car service operators in a US city, service area, metro region, or airport for airport pickups and drop-offs, weddings, proms, corporate travel, nights out, wine tours, or hourly charters (e.g. "book a limo in NYC", "find a black SUV to JFK", "car service from EWR", "car service in North Jersey", "party bus for 12 people in Miami"). Returns only verified active Limodia operators. Unverified operators are never returned by MCP v1. A published operator site is not required for marketplace discovery; booking is completed through a returned booking link when one is available. Results include location, verification badges, verified Limodia customer rating/review count when available, passenger capacity, vehicle categories, vehicle image, amenities from profile data and configured vehicle add-ons, insurance verification status when current, price band, and a booking deeplink that opens the operator's booking page with the trip details already filled in. When BOTH pickup and dropoff are provided, each verified operator additionally carries exact all-in totals per vehicle class for that route in "quotes" (capacity-filtered when a passenger count is given) — so always pass pickup and dropoff when the user stated them. When presenting results, show the matching operators as a list of options with their vehicle types, capacity, price band, rating, and badges. When the results render in the widget, do not repeat operator details in text — give one short sentence and offer next steps (e.g. refine the search or proceed to booking). Time is not needed to search. If the user is only searching, comparing, or asking for prices, call this tool without datetime and do not ask for pickup time. But if the user moves to book and no time was given, ask for the pickup time before presenting a booking_deeplink or "Book now" link. After the user supplies the time, call this tool again with the complete ISO-8601 pickup datetime and present the returned link. Never guess or infer a pickup datetime, and never embed a guessed time in a booking link.

city.description: US city or area/airport to search. Accepts a city, metro/service region, airport name, or airport code, e.g. "New York", "North Jersey", "Newark Airport", or "EWR". Required.

pickup.description: Pickup location as free text (address, airport code, or landmark), e.g. "JFK Terminal 4". Used to prefill the booking page.

dropoff.description: Dropoff location as free text. Used to prefill the booking page.

datetime.description: Optional requested pickup time as an ISO-8601 datetime, e.g. "2026-08-01T18:30:00". When omitted, search still runs, but verified booking links are withheld until the user provides the pickup time. Never guess this value.

passengers.description: Number of passengers. Operators whose vehicles are known to be too small are filtered out.

vehicleType.description: Desired vehicle category, e.g. "executive_sedan", "suv", "stretch_limo", "party_bus", "sprinter". Matched loosely against each operator's fleet.
